newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan blue chip drives bourse slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan blue chip drives bourse slightly higher.

text.p: The Casablanca stock market on Wednesday closed its two-hour trading slightly higher, pushed up by market blue chip ONA group.
The bourse all-share index rose 0.02 percent to close at 428.19 points from 428.09 points on the previous session.

"The bourse index registered a slight rise due largely to surge in ONA shares in Wednesday's session...Investors expect the bourse to consolidate its upward trend this month," a Casablanca-based stockbroker said.
ONA, Morocco's largest private conglomerate which has a market capitalisation of 7.7 billion dirhams, rose four dirhams to close at 455 dirhams.
Despite ONA registering a drop in half-year profits, its four listed subsidiaries posted significant positive results in the first half of 1996.
The subsidiaries are Centrale Laitiere, Leusieur, Cosumar and Finaciere Diwan.
Other traded stocks lost ground and fell by three to 26 dirhams in Wednesday's session, a bourse official said.
The traded volume on the official market dropped to 24.2 million dirhams from 36.8 million dirhams on Tuesday.
